name: unsafe fn dealloc (ptr : * mut u8 , layout : Layout)
rule: For safety, `ptr` must point to a block of memory currently allocated via the global allocator (the allocator registered with `#[global_allocator]`, if any, or the `std` crate’s default allocator).
api: unsafe fn dealloc (ptr : * mut u8 , layout : core::alloc::layout::Layout)
